name: nh3h2o_absorption_chiller
title: Single-effect ammonia-water absorption chiller with rectifier
summary: Single-effect NH3-H2O absorption chiller at one operating point with rectifier, solution and refrigerant heat exchangers: pressures from the saturation of the refrigerant, strong and weak solution compositions, circulation ratio, heat rates of all components, COP, and the 14 state points as arrays for the diagrams.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (any three of T, P, X, Q, H, S, U, V)

origin.source_path: written for the library (standard single-effect NH3-H2O cycle, Herold, Radermacher, Klein 1996)
authors: CoolSolve project (S. Quoilin, ISES, University of Liège); drafted with Claude (Anthropic)

verification.summary: Whole-cycle energy balance closes to 2e-11 W on 22 kW (E_check); mass and ammonia balances hold by construction; qualities of the two-phase states lie in [0, 1]. COP 0.45 and circulation ratio 6.3 are plausible for a single-effect NH3-H2O chiller. No reference solution exists.
verification.reference: none (new model); property model IAPWS G4-01 verified in CoolSolve against the guideline tables
verification.notes: Valid while x[4] < x[1] (generator above about 96 C for these conditions); COP vs T_gen: 0.278 (100 C), 0.433 (110), 0.454 (120), 0.440 (130), 0.409 (140).

history.action: added (new model on the EES fluid NH3H2O, CoolSolve branch feat/nh3h2o)
